question: The part of the cytoskeleton made from the protein actin is called?
text: The part of the cytoskeleton made from actin is called **microfilaments**, also known as **actin filaments**. They are the thinnest of the three cytoskeletal fiber types, at about 7 nm in diameter. They help with cell shape, muscle contraction, cell movement, and cytokinesis (the division of the cytoplasm).
